(Japanese: '''ミスター・クロウ''' ''Mister Crow'') is a character from [[Pokémon Try Adventure]].
==History==
[[File:Mister Crow shadowed.png|thumb|left|200px|Mister Crow shadowed]]
Mister Crow first appeared in ''[[TA01|A Meeting of Fate]]'' where after [[Katsuya]] rescued a man on top of {{p|Steelix}}, he introduced himself via his {{p|Honchkrow}} to the four Trainers.

In ''[[TA11|Treasure Hunt in the Sea!]]'', Mister Crow once again relied on his Honchkrow to inform the group that they need to find some buried treasure out in the sea.
